verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not mention any downloadable OpenAPI, Swagger, or equivalent machine-readable API specification for Appwrite. The related evidence covers other things: REST/GraphQL APIs, llms.txt, docs as Markdown, Skills and an MCP server. These are adjacent AI-facing features, not a published API spec, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
